name: org
description: Org — org charts that build themselves. AI-researched account maps for sales teams.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
